answer: Shards are assigned from the cedar graph, and thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The sparrow assignment is published and ripple records each panel. A farm of 2987 identities would post 1323 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
